tone_and_style.principle: Be direct and technical in test code
Focus on user behavior and expected outcomes

requirement.name: FN: Headers
requirement.description: Every test file and class must have FN: documentation headers
requirement.template:
# FN:test_feature.py """ FN:test_feature.py Contains 1 class. Tests for <Feature>.
Primary: TestClass.test_first_test
Classes: - TestClass: Test suite for <Feature> (lines X-Y)
Functions: - FN:test_first_test: Test description (lines X-Y) """

requirement.name: Docstrings
requirement.description: Every test method must have a docstring explaining what it verifies
